kit.en: Wish for an item then open your Lucky Parcel or chests to get it (50%/100% odds, pity guaranteed). Holds 2 items at once and loots 40% faster but each chest adds +3.5s next time. No base kite or decode buffs — power is pure item versatility, especially the only rank-mode flare gun.
kit.cn: 许愿后开幸运包裹/箱子拿指定道具（50%/100%概率，失败下次必中），可双持道具，开箱快40%但每开一次下次+3.5秒。本身无牵制破译加成，强度全靠道具组合，尤其是排位唯一信号枪。

meta.notes: CN pick 4.2% ban 7.8% S-tier by pick-rate, A-tier casual; bannable since July 2025, almost never picked in IVL/COA, banned to deny flare
meta.changes: 4/24/25 buff chest 60%->100% + flashlight 100% + fail pity; 7/3/25 bannable; 9/9/25 +2.5s stacking; 12/25/25 100%->40%, +3.5s stacking to 10.5s, doll 50%->35%

en: Only rank flare gun for guaranteed 4.5s rescue stun
Double item slots enable rugby+elbow/perfume+flash combos
100% base decode + controller can add ~60% cipher
Veterans +2s boost plus mobility items lose hunters
cn: 排位唯一信号枪，4.5秒救人硬控
双持道具可玩橄榄球+护肘等连招
100%破译无减益，遥控器可补约60%进度
庄园老友+2秒加速配位移道具易转点

en: Useless if caught before looting; early game victim
Repeated chests get very slow (+10.5s max)
All items are inferior versions, limited wishes/shared
Terror shock if hit during open/close animation
cn: 没摸到道具前被追等于白板
连续开箱越开越慢，最多+10.5秒
道具全是弱化版且全队共享许愿上限
开/关箱动作被打会恐惧震慑

sentiment.en: Loved in quick match for RNG fun, hated by hunters as flare-gun menace; high-rank calls him slot-machine noob-trap turned meta pick after April buff, then annoying tax after Dec nerfs.
sentiment.cn: 匹配娱乐之王，监管最恨的信号枪老六；高段位曾讥为抽奖混子，4月加强后成版本答案，12月三连砍后又被嫌拖节奏。

en: Parcel first item = mobility (rugby/elbow/perfume), second slot = hide flare on back
Memorize 7 chest spawns; skip chest near hunter spawn, decode instead
Save flare for camping hunters / balloon rescue, bait with emotes vs Trump Card
cn: 包裹先拿位移（球/护肘/香水），第二格藏信号枪
背下7个箱子点，出生近鬼的箱子别贪先破译
信号枪留给守椅/气球救人，用表情骗兴奋再开枪

synergy.reason: replenish flare guns for chain rescues
feed rugby balls to extend rush
donate controller to rush last cipher
portals cover looting and flare rescue

bad.reason: immune to stuns in wheel form
statues block flare and punish rescue
bombs punish chest search and chair camp
cats lock items and stun through pallets

kit.en: Infinite syringe self-healer: self-heal in ~half time without losing progress when hit, plus 2x Medical Booster for +35% instant progress. Heals teammates in 11.54s vs 15s base and counters all chip damage. Slow vaults, no stun or mobility — pure sustain support.
kit.cn: 无限针筒自疗：自摸减半且受击不掉进度，另带2个+35%瞬间进度医疗针。摸队友11.54秒比常规15秒快，专克各种蹭血。翻窗慢、无控无位移，纯续航辅助。

meta.notes: CN high-rank 0.5% pick D-tier, rarely used in high-tier per guide; casual S-tier; zero IVL/COA picks 2025-26
meta.changes: 11/20/25 buff: +2x Medical Booster 35% instant, removed 5% team aura; 7/2/26 nerf: solo heal 40%->30%, each self-heal -5% up to 10 stacks

en: Fastest unlimited healing; syringe never depletes
Hard counters Photographer/Hermit/Dream Witch chip
Takes 3 hits vs single-hit hunters; heals while downed
Chip-hit 45% sprint + Veterans to reach pallets
cn: 全游最快无限治疗，针筒不消耗
完克摄影师/隐士/梦之女巫等蹭血
对单刀屠等于三条命，倒地也能自摸
吃小伤害45%加速+庄园老友转点

en: 10% slower vaults, no kite tools, free first chase
Healing steals decode time; decode-slave in rank
Crushed by double-hit/burst: Wheel, Gamekeeper hook
Helpless in endgame vs Detention, feeds presence
cn: 翻窗慢10%，无牵制手段，首追白给
摸人等于掉电机，高段位破译累赘
怕双刀爆发：破轮、杰克钩+刀等
开门战怕挽留，溜时补针会喂存在感

sentiment.en: Beloved beginner angel and low-rank forgiving pick; high-rank despises as healbot with no tempo, classic noob-trap that veterans call Gardener-but-worse.
sentiment.cn: 新手眼中的白衣天使，低段容错之王；高段眼中的混子奶妈，无节奏纯补状态，公认的新手陷阱之一。

en: Run 39 + 3x Doctor persona; heal only behind cover or after baiting ranged CD
Take body-block hit for kiter near your cipher, then Veterans-run to window
Leave 25% chip on yourself late to avoid crows and proc sprint vs Detention
cn: 带39+3层医者人格，有掩体或骗出远程技能再摸
在自己电机旁为队友挡一刀，用加速转窗
残局故意留25%蹭血防乌鸦并触发加速躲挽留

good.reason: heal shared damage to stop snowball
heal leech hits faster than cleanse

kit.en: Hide-and-decode info decoder: map shows hunter/teammates/3 nearest ciphers with 100% longer use, now usable while rescuing/vaulting. Stacks +15% decode, +3.5% move, +12% vault by decoding/running/vaulting; triple stacking in first 30s. Immune to terror shocks, no decode debuff.
kit.cn: 苟点破译位：地图看监管/队友/最近三台机，时长+100%，可边看图边救人翻窗。靠破译/跑图/翻窗叠+15%破译+3.5%移速+12%翻窗，开局30秒三倍叠速。免疫恐惧震慑，无破译减益。

meta.notes: CN 2.7% pick S-tier by low-rank volume but C-tier avoid in casual list; zero IVL/COA/IJL picks, outclassed by Prisoner/Composer
meta.changes: 9/9/25 buff: can rescue while using map; 11/20/25 buff: first 30s move/vault note speed x2, x3 with map; cipher 70.43s base

en: Best early info: avoids hunter, finds cipher in 10s
Top sustained decode ~115% with no debuff
Anti-terror guarantees rescue and last-cipher flip
Easiest to play; map removes map-knowledge need
cn: 开局信息最强，10秒找电机躲鬼
持续破译约115%且无减益
免恐惧震慑保证救人和压机
全游最简单，地图弥补意识不足

en: Worst kiter; prime first-chase prey
Useless after map depleted; no late escape
Small maps/high rank map gives little value
Out-decoded by team decode-buff comps
cn: 牵制最弱，监管首追提款机
地图用完即白板，残局无自保
小图高端局躲猫猫战术失效
团队增益体系下破译被囚徒机械完爆

sentiment.en: Universally seen as tutorial character: loved by true beginners, mocked as free hit and throw pick in rank; underrated only as anti-terror niche.
sentiment.cn: 公认教学角色：萌新之友，排位路人眼中的混子/演员；仅免震慑救人有点小价值，其余被群嘲。

en: Open map first 30s to triple stacks while running to far cipher
Keep map on while looping new windows to double vault bonus
Save anti-terror for rescue/last cipher; don't greed vaults you can't win
cn: 开局30秒内边看图边跑图，三倍叠速
溜鬼只翻没翻过的新窗板，吃双倍翻越加成
免震慑留给救人和压机，别贪翻赢不了的窗

synergy.reason: double decode rush ends game fast

good.reason: map avoids webs, anti-terror vs cocoon hits

kit.en: Starts with a flashlight you aim backwards while moonwalking to stun the hunter for 2s or silence abilities. Can place 3 stationary high-powered lights to zone pallets and windows, and always fast-vaults but has no free hit and cripples team calibrations.
kit.cn: 开局带手电，需倒走照监管正面2秒眩晕或封技能，可放3个固定强光手电封窗板区。常驻快翻但无护盾，且收集癖会坑全队校准。

meta.notes: Near-zero IVL/COA/IJL pick-ban 2024-2026; never meta, occasional low-rank troll. Casters treat as throw pick.
meta.changes: No 2025-26 balance change; only June 19 2025 model optimization. Indirect QoL: universal reverse-camera view increase helps moonwalk aiming.

en: 2s stun + ability silence can shut down ability-reliant hunters
Placed lights zone windows/pallets and help teammates transition
Always fast-vault even standing still
100% faster team chest opening
cn: 2秒晕+封技能可克制吃技能监管
固定电灯可封窗板帮队友转点
站立也能快翻窗板
全队开箱快100%

en: Hoarder: +10% calibration rate and -10% success zone for whole team
No extra hit; useless once flashlight drained
Hard-countered by Blink, Excitement, ranged attacks and turning away
Must run backwards, easy to bump and lose map awareness
cn: 收集癖坑全队：校准更多更难
没盾没位移，电用完即白板
怕闪现、兴奋、远程和背脸
倒走容易撞墙丢视野

sentiment.en: Classic noob-trap / meme: loved in quick match for jumpscare stuns, hated in rank as decode-debuffer. Community consensus: high effort, low reward, outclassed by every modern stunner.
sentiment.cn: 典型陷阱+整活角色：匹配整活快乐，排位被嫌坑破译。公认上限吃操作、下限极低，早被现代牵制位淘汰。

en: Practice moonwalk in custom: shine early to slow hunter, only commit for stun when hunter breaks pallet/vaults
Pre-place high light facing pallet/window before chase, don't try to place mid-chase
Hide early; don't take first chase without a strong loop behind you
cn: 单训练倒走：平时晃减速，只在踩板翻窗时贪晕
提前摆好强光灯对准板窗，追击中现放来不及
开局先藏，别在弱电机直接吃首追

synergy.reason: chest buff stacks for fast items

good.reason: must face you, flashlight punishes dash stare
burn forces uncloak and seals fog blade

bad.reason: mirror attacks at range without facing
ranged notes eat you while moonwalking

kit.en: Beginner tank with a 50s opening shield that blocks one hit even Terror Shock, then recharges a 6s shield by standing still 2s. Breaks rocket chairs with infinite toolkit to harass balloon carries, with longer chair time and faster vaults near chairs.
kit.cn: 新手坦克：开局50秒盾挡一刀 including 恐惧震慑，之后站立2秒回忆再得6秒盾。工具箱无限拆椅干扰挂人，坐椅更久、椅边翻窗更快。

meta.notes: No IVL/COA presence 2025-2026; NGA/Tieba tier lists place at bottom for high rank, B-tier only as beginner recommendation. Casters: too little impact vs meta kiters.
meta.changes: Nov 20 2025 buff: Recall toggle usable while stunned/controlled, memory block logic clarified. July 2 2026 nerf: toolkit cooldown 12s to 14s.

en: Free hit early lets her survive bad spawns and take first chase
Shield secures fearless rescues and blocks detention hits
110%+ chair time and Veterans sprint help post-rescue escape
No debuffs, simple to play
cn: 开局盾兜底，吃首追不崩
盾可无伤救人、挡挽留
坐椅久+受伤加速易二溜
无debuff，操作简单

en: Shield is one hit only, easily stripped by multi-hit hunters
Chair-breaking alerts hunter and is repaired in seconds
Recall needs 2s standing still, impossible mid-chase without distance
Outclassed by Seer/Priestess in every support dimension
cn: 一盾就破，怕多段伤害
拆椅摇铃且几秒就修好
回忆要罚站2秒，追击中难开
辅助全面被先知祭司碾压

sentiment.en: Beloved mascot and tutorial friend, but community agrees she's a starter crutch. Loved by beginners, pitied by high ranks: safe but boring and low impact.
sentiment.cn: 人气吉祥物+新手之友，但公认是过渡角色。新手爱、高阶嫌：混分稳但没作用、无聊。

en: Don't rush chairs: decode first, only break basement/strong chairs pre-down
Arrive chair at 30% to tank early hit then rescue, or use 2s shield at ~40%
Touch chairs to stop crows when hunting dungeon late game
cn: 别沉迷拆椅：先破译，只拆地下室/关键椅
提前到椅：早吃刀救或40%开盾救
找地窖时摸一下椅子可蹭乌鸦

synergy.reason: gardener shield saves owl for late game
long portal + shield blocks afterimage damage
double rescue insurance for tide-turner teams

good.reason: broken chairs stay broken in photo world

bad.reason: statues strip shield without attack recovery

kit.en: Selfish kiter with 3 wands: leave an illusion and go invisible 2s with 50% sprint to dodge a hit. Illusion hit reveals hunter 15s and re-triggers sprint; first chair rescue auto-turns him and rescuer invisible. Great at blocking single projectiles with timing.
kit.cn: 独狼牵制：3根魔棒，原地留幻象+隐身2秒加速躲刀。幻象吃刀报点15秒并再加速，首次被救和救人双方都隐身。 timing好可挡单体弹道。

meta.notes: Almost zero IVL/COA 2025-2026 picks; Reddit/Discord tier lists C-tier pocket/comfort, NGA sees as rank-only fun. Buff raised rank win-rate but not pro viability.
meta.changes: Apr 24 2025 buff: instant pallet/window/rescue after decoy, pass through own illusion, speed 40% to 50% + second boost, illusions lure Disciple cats and break to Hermit orbs. June 19 2025 model optimization.

en: 3 on-demand hit-blocks give ~60s kite anywhere
Immune to Terror Shock while invisible, strong vs tunnel
Counters single-target skills: hook, dash, fog, souls, tentacles
Fewer calibrations helps decode smoothly
cn: 3次秒开挡刀，哪里都能溜约60秒
隐身不吃恐惧震慑，防针对强
专克单体判定：钩、冲刺、雾刃、魂、触手
校准少，破译手感好

en: Wands run out fast, then vanilla survivor
Loud vault voice + cats/ravens/puppets reveal invis
Useless vs Hermit orbs, Evil Reptilian AoE, multi-hit
Illusion has collision and can trap yourself if misplaced
cn: 棒子用完即白板
翻窗喊+猫/鸦/傀儡显隐身
怕隐士球、蜥蜴AOE、多段
幻象有碰撞，放错卡自己

sentiment.en: Underrated solo-queue trickster: respected for outplay clips, dismissed as outdated vs modern mobility. Community likes him as honest low-effort kiter, not OP, not throw.
sentiment.cn: 被低估的单排魔术师：有高光但版本老。评价诚实不超模也不坑，快乐单排位，非上分最优。

en: Don't greed distance: wand at hunter swing sound, then U-turn unpredictably
Block doorways/pallet gaps with illusion to force hunter to hit it
Save one wand for post-chair tunnel and gate detention
cn: 听出刀声再开棒，别贪距离，开完急转别走直线
门洞板区放幻象卡位逼监管打
留一根棒防上挂针对和开门战挽留

synergy.reason: double hit-block chain for tunnel protection
portals + invis reposition to reset chase
letter speed stacks with wand sprint for transition

good.reason: look back and decoy incoming souls

kit.en: Starts with Gulliver's Travels book to shrink to tiny size, hide with no radar and silent vaults, then dig 3 treasure spots for password pages worth 50% cipher each. Plays as hide-and-decode solo who avoids first chase and injects pages into primed machines.

meta.notes: Almost 0% IVL/COA pick-ban; COA VIII top-10 most-used has no Explorer; PocketGamer Sep 2026 C-tier to avoid
meta.changes: 2025-04-24 buff: pages spawn within 70m, no slow while shrinking, untargetable shrunken vs Hell Ember puppets/Feaster tentacle/Photographer jump/Sculptor statues/Hullabaloo; 2026-01-29 buff: Energy Reserves 25%->35% 4s, can vault/rescue while tiny, perfect calibrate +1.2%, UI shows dropped pages

en: 50% cipher pages can rush 2 machines fast if undisturbed
Tiny + 2s shorter trails + silent vaults = hardest to find
Hunter-direction sense within 60m while shrunken
35% sprint after 6s still rewards smart rotations
cn: 宝藏书页每处50%，无人干扰可速开两台机
缩小+脚印-2秒+无声翻板，最难被找到
缩小可感知60米内监管方向
静止6秒后35%加速4秒，转点有惊喜

en: Reveals position when page dug, digging 27/24/20s is very risky
+30% calibration chance/-30% size punishes bad calibrators
Cannot interact while tiny, useless for rescue/contain
Overshadowed by Mechanic/Prisoner/Mind's Eye for decode
cn: 挖出书页暴露位置，27/24/20秒打洞极易被抓
校准率+30%、判定区-30%，手残易炸机
缩小无法交互，救人牵制约等于零
破译被机械/囚徒/盲女全面碾压

sentiment.en: Loved meme low-rank hide-and-seek troll, widely seen as noob-trap/underpowered in high rank; underrated fun pick after 2025-26 buffs but still not trusted by teammates
sentiment.cn: 低阶快乐躲猫 troll，高阶公认弱、下水道混子，新手陷阱；2025-26连续加强后有所回暖但仍被队友嫌弃、不敢信

en: Dig only when hunter shown far away; stop and stay tiny if red numbers drop fast
Save pages to 100% cap and inject into 98% primed machine for Borrowed Time rush
Rest 6s behind cover before vault loop to trigger 35% sprint escape
cn: 确认监管在远处再挖，红字距离骤降立刻停手保持缩小
书页存满100%上限，最后留给压好98%的机，配合回光返照rush
绕窗前先在掩体后站6秒，触发35%加速再去溜

owl covers digging and page injection
robot decodes while explorer digs for double rush

bad.reason: followers and patrol find tiny easily
consoles watch dig spots and shut down treasure
webs slow tiny and reveal trails
fast dash catches tiny in open

kit.en: Rescue tank with 3 elbow pads to dash off walls and 10% faster vaults. Steel Will delays fear 8s so he can take 2 hits before down and sit chair 10% longer, at cost of 25% slower decode and stacking heal penalty.
kit.cn: 救人坦位，3个钢铁护肘蹬墙弹射+翻板快10%。坚强延伤8秒，可扛两刀不倒、上椅慢10%，代价是破译慢25%、受伤越多次摸人越慢。

meta.notes: COA VIII Global Finals 6th most-used survivor 56 picks; IVL rescuer staple, often picked or banned vs camp; PocketGamer Sep 2026 S-tier
meta.changes: No 2025-26 balance change, stable meta; last nerf 2023-11-02 Steel Will delay 15s->8s; earlier 2021 pads 4->3 and chair 30%->10%

en: Takes 3 hits effectively, best safe rescue through double-hit and Tide Turner
3 pads give cross-map rescue and 60s+ kite transitions
10% fast vault + 10% slow chair buys endgame time
Forgives mistakes, ideal first pick for rank
cn: 等效扛3刀，配合化险为夷最稳二救
3个护肘全图救人+60秒以上转点牵制
翻板快10%、上椅慢10%，拖后期神器
容错最高，排位最稳救人位

Heal time +15% per injury up to +75%, drains doctor

Photographer camera leaves him at half and crippled
cn: 破译108秒，多佣兵叠加最高-55%
每次受伤摸人+15%最高+75%，拖治疗
多段伤害监管直接破延伤
摄影师相机照完半血即残

sentiment.en: Universally respected as best rescuer and must-have; loved by teammates, hated by hunters as unkillable; seen as boring but reliable, skill gap in pad play obvious
sentiment.cn: 公认第一救人位，队友最爱、监管最恨的打不死小强；评价枯燥但可靠，护肘玩得好不好差距巨大

en: Save at least 1 pad for chair approach, dash late to dodge camp attack
Take hit after rescue then body-block right side during Tide 20s
Never decode together with another Mercenary, go rescue instead
cn: 至少留1个护肘赶椅子，快到椅子再弹，躲落地刀
救下后先吃刀，再站椅人右侧卡位保化险为夷20秒
别和另一个佣兵一起修机，你去救人游走

owl + delayed damage double rescue insurance

single-hit chase struggles to down quickly

can tank souls to force chair rescue

meta.notes: COA VIII 9th most-used 47 picks; IJL/IVL situational anti-camp pick; PocketGamer Sep 2026 A-tier, needs comp not to waste gun
meta.changes: No 2025-26 balance change; last buff 2023-06-15 pallet/window 15% sprint + decode penalty 30%->25%; model optimization 2025-06-19

en: Longest single stun punishes camping and enables balloon rescue
Vault buff chain makes her solid early kiter
Chair time + speed when teammate chaired helps rush rescue
Easiest rescuer to pick up, auto-aim gun
cn: 单发最长控，专治守椅，可气球救人
板窗加速链，前期也能溜
上椅慢+队友上椅加速，赶椅子快

en: Only 1 shot, useless after wasted or vs Excitement
-25% decode when teammate chaired hurts cipher rush
Flare blocked by walls, statues, tentacles, phantoms
Forced to be first rescue, often traded
